summary: YC is accepting applications for its Fall 2026 Batch. Official pages confirm an on-time deadline of July 27, 2026 at 8pm PT, an October-to-December in-person batch in San Francisco, and YC's $500,000 standard investment.

proposed_event.name: Y Combinator Fall 2026 Batch
proposed_event.description: 3-month in-person accelerator with $500K standard investment, mentorship, and investor introductions.

dates.date_range_text: Fall 2026 batch takes place October to December in San Francisco; on-time applications close July 27, 2026 at 8pm PT.

sources.title: Apply to Y Combinator
sources.supports: Confirms YC is accepting applications for the Fall 2026 Batch, the batch runs October to December in San Francisco, the on-time deadline is July 27 at 8pm PT, decisions are due by August 28, and the batch is in-person at YC's San Francisco campus.

sources.title: The Y Combinator Deal
sources.supports: Confirms YC's standard deal invests $500,000, including $125,000 for 7% and $375,000 on an uncapped MFN SAFE, plus access to YC resources.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.supports: Confirms the YC batch takes place in person in San Francisco with a 3-day in-person retreat, weekly meetups, a 3-month program, open applications to startups anywhere, and $500,000 invested in each company.

notes: Exact program start date, end date, and Demo Day date were not published on the checked official pages, so those fields are null.
The official apply page says late applications may still be considered after the on-time deadline, but without a guaranteed response time.
